maddeler.e:
غللتن (form I)
# غَلَلْتُنَّ (ḡalaltunna) /ɣa.lal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of غَلَّ (ḡalla)
# غُلِلْتُنَّ (ḡuliltunna) /ɣu.lil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of غَلَّ (ḡalla) and غُلَّ (ḡulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
